build_dataset_filetypes_response: build a dataset filetypes response by querying HuggingFace Hub for file extension counts
get_filetypes_from_archives: get filetypes from zip archives in a HuggingFace dataset repository
get_counter_from_archive: get a counter of file extensions inside a single zip archive from a dataset
get_filetypes: get filetypes by counting file extensions from a list of repository siblings
run_dataset_filetypes_job_runner: run the dataset filetypes job runner to compute file extension statistics for a dataset
